tbesh_html:
1) wisdom, sound knowledge, success, sound or efficient wisdom, abiding success
1a) sound or efficient wisdom
1b) abiding success (of the effect of sound wisdom)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: support or (by implication) ability, i.e. (direct) help, (in purpose) an undertaking, (intellectual) understanding
strongs_1890.derivation: or תֻּשִׁיָּה; from an unused root probably meaning to substantiate;
strongs_1890.kjv_def: enterprise, that which (thing as it) is, substance, (sound) wisdom, working.
